About Us

We are a licensed behavioral residential care provider in Tolleson, Arizona — founded on a simple belief: every child deserves a safe, structured, and nurturing place to heal and grow.

"

Every child deserves a safe place to grow, a structured environment to heal, and a compassionate team that believes in their potential — no matter where they've been.

Our Mission — Preferred Residential Homes
Our Story

Compassionate Youth Residential Care

Preferred Residential Homes provides a safe, supportive, and structured environment for youth in need of stability, emotional support, and behavioral health guidance. Founded on the belief that every young person deserves a genuine home where they feel safe, seen, and supported — not just placed.

Under the leadership of Dr. Odilia S. Kwateng — a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner with over 19 years of healthcare and behavioral health experience — our home was established to fill a critical gap in the community: quality, structured, trauma-informed residential care that treats every child as an individual, not a case number.

We are licensed by the Arizona Department of Health Services as a Behavioral Health Residential Facility, and we take that responsibility seriously. Every decision we make, every policy we follow, and every person we hire is guided by one question: "Is this in the best interest of the child?"

Our Vision

A Community Where Every Child Has the Opportunity to Thrive

We envision a future where no child falls through the cracks — where every young person who comes through our doors leaves with greater confidence, stronger skills, and a clear path forward.

Our vision is to be the residential care provider that families, caseworkers, and communities trust completely — known for excellence, compassion, and outcomes that last.

What We Stand For

Our Core Values

These six values guide every decision we make and every interaction we have.

❤️

Compassion

We lead with empathy — treating every child, family, and team member with kindness and genuine care.

🤝

Integrity

We do what we say and say what we do — honest, transparent, and accountable in everything.

🛡️

Safety

Physical and emotional safety is non-negotiable. Every decision starts with "Is this safe for the child?"

🌱

Growth

We believe every child has the capacity to grow — and we invest in creating the conditions for that growth daily.

🏠

Family

Family connection is central to healing. We honor and strengthen the bonds that matter most.

⭐

Excellence

We hold ourselves to the highest standards — because the children and families we serve deserve nothing less.
